    Sample beta unit by unit (block-diagonal posterior)

    dot-sample_beta_units.Rd

    For K=1: each unit's posterior is scalar N(m_j, v_j) — no matrix ops. For K>1: Cholesky of [K x K] per unit.

    .sample_beta_units(XtWX, XtWy, tau, sigma2, K, J0, prior_mean = NULL)

    Arguments

    XtWX

    List of J0 [K x K] matrices (precomputed).

    XtWy

    List of J0 [K] vectors (current iteration).

    tau

    Numeric vector length K: current dispersion SDs.

    sigma2

    Scalar: current observation noise variance.

    K

    Integer.

    J0

    Integer.

    prior_mean

    Optional list of J0 [K] vectors. Default NULL (zero).

    Value

    Numeric vector length K*J0.
